title: Admin Dashboard Load and Visual Fidelity
description: Verify that the admin dashboard loads correctly with full functionality and matches the expected dark/gold theme with proper visual fidelity.

steps.description: Log in as an admin user
Navigate to the admin dashboard page
Check that the dashboard UI elements are fully loaded and functional
Verify the theme is dark/gold as specified
Confirm all configuration options are accessible

title: Authentication - Admin Role Identification and Badge Display
description: Ensure that the authentication system correctly identifies admin users and displays admin badges on their profiles.

steps.description: Log in using Google OAuth with an admin user account
Verify that the user is authenticated successfully
Check that the user role is identified as admin
Confirm that the admin badge is displayed on the user profile and relevant UI elements

title: Authentication - Regular User Login
description: Validate that a non-admin user can successfully log in via Google OAuth and the user does not have admin privileges or badges.

steps.description: Log in using Google OAuth with a regular user account
Confirm successful login
Verify that the user role is non-admin
Check that no admin badge is present on the profile or UI

title: Database Row Level Security - Admin Permissions
description: Verify that database Row Level Security policies allow admin users to insert, update, and delete media and configuration records.

steps.description: Log in as admin user
Attempt to insert a new media record into the database
Confirm insert operation is successful
Attempt to update an existing configuration record
Confirm update operation is successful
Attempt to delete a media record
Confirm delete operation is successful

title: Database Row Level Security - Public Read Access
description: Ensure that public (non-authenticated) users have read-only access to public content as enforced by database policies.

steps.description: Access the application without logging in
Attempt to read featured content and music genre data
Verify that the content loads successfully
Attempt to insert or update data without authentication
Confirm that insert/update operations are denied

title: Media Upload - Successful Upload by Admin
description: Test that an admin can successfully upload media files via the upload section with integration to Supabase storage.

steps.description: Log in as admin user
Navigate to the Upload Section
Select a valid media file for upload
Click on the upload button
Verify that the upload completes successfully without errors
Confirm the media is available in Supabase storage and listed in the media database

title: Media Upload - Permission Error Handling for Non-Admin
description: Verify that a non-admin user attempting to upload media receives proper permission error messages.

steps.description: Log in as a regular (non-admin) user
Attempt to access the Upload Section
Confirm access is denied or upload functionality is disabled
If allowed to attempt upload, try uploading a media file
Verify that a permission error message is displayed and upload does not proceed

title: Media Upload - Network Error Handling
description: Simulate network failure during media upload and ensure proper error messages are shown and upload does not corrupt data.

steps.description: Log in as admin user
Navigate to Upload Section and select a valid media file
Simulate network interruption during the upload process
Verify that upload terminates with a network error message
Confirm partial or corrupted files are not stored or listed in the media database

title: Featured Content Pagination and Dynamic Update
description: Validate that the featured content section displays content with pagination and dynamically updates when new content is added.

steps.description: Access the featured content section as a logged-in user
Verify that the first page of featured content loads correctly
Navigate between pages using pagination controls
Confirm correct featured content is displayed for each page
As admin, add new featured content via admin dashboard
Verify that the new content appears in the featured section dynamically without page reload

title: Featured Content - Media Playback Functionality
description: Ensure that media playback in the featured section works correctly with functional audio visualizations.

steps.description: Navigate to the featured content section
Select a featured media item and start playback
Verify that audio plays without interruption
Confirm that the audio visualization components display reactive and live visuals synchronized with the audio
Pause and resume playback
Verify playback controls respond correctly

title: Genre Library - Local Storage Integration
description: Confirm that the genre library page loads music by genre and caches data using local storage to enhance browsing experience.

steps.description: Navigate to the genre library page
Verify that genre lists and music items load correctly
Select a genre and browse music entries
Confirm that data is cached in local storage after loading
Reload the page or revisit the genre library
Verify that cached data is used to load genres quickly without a full server fetch

title: Fan Club - Posting and Media Sharing Persistence
description: Test that the fan club feature allows users to create posts and share media with persistent storage and correct display.

steps.description: Log in as a regular user
Navigate to the fan club section
Create a new text post
Share a media item in the post
Submit the post
Verify the post and media appear immediately in the fan club feed
Reload the application
Confirm that the post and media remain visible and persisted

title: Settings Page - Site Configuration Management
description: Verify that admin users can access the Settings page to manage site-wide configurations and featured slots correctly.

steps.description: Log in as admin user
Navigate to the Settings page
Confirm that all configuration options and featured slot management features are displayed
Modify a site configuration setting and save changes
Verify changes are applied and persisted after refreshing the page
Update featured slots and verify updates are reflected in the featured content section
